Author: qx
Name: Doman Mahjong Solver
Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and either suggests the best discard or plays the match for you.
Changelog: v0.1.4.0: added active tile-feeding mode (MultiClientEnableFeed). When enabled, blocker role will preferentially discard tiles the target is waiting on (target's ukeire), enabling one 4-client (4开) instance to feed the other to win. The target broadcasts its wait set via the local Named-Pipe IPC; blockers pick the discard that lands in that set. Defaults to OFF to avoid breaking existing setups — toggle in Settings > Multi-Client. v0.1.3.4 telemetry backoff kept.
